intel_energy.title: Energy, water and resources
intel_energy.subtitle: What each resource costs and emits, where it goes, what was used while nothing ran, and what could be done about it.
intel_energy.even_split: Some readings cover more than an hour; their use is spread evenly over the hours they cover.
intel_energy.no_meters: No meters yet. Add a meter for each resource you want to watch.
intel_energy.no_breakdown: Nothing to break down for this resource and period.
intel_energy.assumptions: Savings use stated assumptions: {movable} of the dearest band's use is taken as movable; {idle} of idle use as avoidable. Every figure shows its basis.
intel_energy.no_recommendations: No open recommendations. Analyse now, or wait for the next run.
intel_energy.decide_in_feed: Approve, carry out and verify recommendations in the intelligence feed.
intel_energy.enter_reading_hint: A person at the meter. Sensors and integrations send their readings automatically.
intel_energy.bulk_hint: One reading per line: meter code, date and time, value, and optionally the parameter. Comma, semicolon or tab separated.
intel_energy.integration_hint: Each line is checked on its own: lines that fail are listed and the rest are saved.
intel_energy.name: Name
intel_energy.factors_hint: Carbon is only worked out with a factor configured here, with its method and published source.
intel_energy.outages_hint: Published load-shedding and supply interruptions. Planned work that overlaps one gets a scheduling hint.
intel_energy.parent_hint: A sub-meter's use is taken out of its parent's before the parent is shared out, so nothing counts twice.
intel_energy.multiplier_hint: CT ratio or pulse value; every reading is multiplied by it.
intel_energy.demand_charge_per_kw: Demand charge per kW per month
intel_energy.bands_hint: A band that ends before it starts runs past midnight. Hours outside every band are charged at the standard rate.
intel_energy.bands_error: Each band needs a name, a rate, days, and a start and end time.
intel_energy.partly_unpriced: Some hours fall outside every band and there is no standard rate.
intel_energy.daily_hint: The last five weeks. Days far outside the previous four weeks are marked.
intel_energy.settings_hint: The figures the recommendations rest on. Each recommendation states the one it uses; change them to match how your plant runs.

order_costs.title: Resource use (from meters)
order_costs.hint: What the energy and water meters say this order consumed. Shown beside its cost, never part of it: nothing is posted from these figures.
